scope: ARWP Image Discovery IDL-01 through IDL-08 applied to canonical Brali sitemap pages that expose a visible informative same-origin image.

findings.evidence: Representative images are selected only from visible informative images inside main content, mapped to same-origin local assets, and verified again after deployment.
The finalizer aligns og:image, twitter:image and WebPage.primaryImageOfPage; Article.image is aligned where an Article node exists.
Only final canonical sitemap pages with a selected representative image receive image:image/image:loc entries; deprecated image sitemap fields are rejected.
Image Discovery reuses non-empty human-authored alt text from the visible page image and does not generate unseen visual details.
Existing max-image-preview:large behavior is preserved and noimageindex is treated as a conflict for Image Discovery records.
Many Brali protocol covers are large editorial assets; Discover-specific size requirements remain a separate quality check and are not treated as universal image-indexing requirements.
Stable crawlable image src URLs remain authoritative; responsive delivery is preserved where already implemented and is not fabricated as an indexing prerequisite.
Existing Brali licensing remains authoritative; deprecated image-sitemap licensing fields are not introduced.
